method: Built-in image_gen, two separate reference-guided generations; transparent PNG masters; palette-constrained native SVG tracing with scripts/trace-walking-artwork.py and vtracer 0.6.15.
constraints: Mixed-breed dog and domestic shorthair tabby cat
No dotted paths, star, compass or orange accents

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent animal illustration for a DNAture website experience selector.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved mixed-breed dog identity; image 2 is the approved mixed-breed domestic shorthair tabby cat identity; image 3 is a linework/style reference only, not the dog identity. Use the ordinary mixed-breed dog from image 1, NOT the retriever from image 3. Preserve the dog's slim medium-size build, modest scruffy short-to-medium coat, asymmetric semi-folded ears, tapered medium muzzle and natural lightly feathered tail. Preserve the cat's ordinary domestic shorthair build, upright ears, tabby markings and curved tail. Healthy, calm, dignified pets.
Style: realistic fine wood/copperplate engraving, tapered fur strokes and crosshatching, crisp detailed anatomy. Duotone deep cool ink teal #092F39 and luminous mint #8FE4D9 only. Match these two characters faithfully while drawing new natural walking poses.
Canvas: landscape 1536 by 1024. Both animals full body, paws on a common baseline, centered as a balanced compact composition with clear breathing room. Dog naturally about twice the cat's shoulder height. All ears, tails, whiskers and paws intact.
Background: genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the animals, including between legs and fine whiskers. No background color, haze, glow, ground, ground shadow or vignette.
No text, logo, accessories, people, clothing, signpost, props, dotted line, path, arrow, star, compass, sparkle, orange or any warm color. Only the two animals, no extra animals. No photographic texture, cartoon outlines or 3D.
Scene: guided companionship. The mixed-breed dog at the left/rear walks gently toward the RIGHT, beside the smaller cat at the right/front which also walks toward the RIGHT. The dog turns its head slightly down toward the cat; the cat glances up/back at the dog, sharing a gentle attentive glance. Their body orientation and natural walking gait clearly move right together. Clear silhouettes with minimal overlap; individually legible feet and tails, no fused anatomy. Mouths closed. Warmth conveyed through calm posture, not human expressions.
